These are semantic coverage families, not a deterministic keyword checklist. Do not repeat an accepted quote with the same normalized economic identity and do not infer a fact or absence from silence. The Company has assessed that certain activities, such as\ninvesting in assets or providing financing to customers, do not constitute its main business activities.\nThe application of Korean IFRS 1118 will not affect the Company’s profit for the period or net assets. In\naddition, local finance centers in the major regions respond to liquidity risk through a regionally integrated\nfinancial structure.\nThe Company’s financial assets subject to financial risk management consist of cash and cash equivalents,\nshort-term financial instruments, trade receivables, financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive\nincome and others, while its financial liabilities consist of trade payables, borrowings, and others.\n(A) Market risk\n(1) Foreign exchange risk\nThe Company is exposed to foreign exchange risk arising from its global operations through transactions in\ncurrencies other than its functional currency. The main currencies in which the Company is exposed to foreign\nexchange risk are the US dollar and European Euro.\nThe Company focuses on minimizing the impact of foreign exchange fluctuation by matching levels of assets\nand liabilities denominated in each foreign currency. This reduces but may not eliminate, the\nforeign exchange risk to which the Company is exposed. Moreover, the Company periodically evaluates and\nmonitors the foreign exchange risk to efficiently mitigate such risk, and the speculative foreign exchange\ntransactions are strictly prohibited.\n(2) Interest rate risk\nInterest rate risk for floating interest rate financial instruments can be defined as the risk of changes in the fair\nvalue of components of the statement of financial position due to changes in the market interest rates, and the\nrisk of changes in the future cash flows of interest income and expenses arising from investing and financing\nactivities.
